svg.title: The Creative Brain — multi-agent architecture
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture highlighting the dispatcher and routing logic between pattern detection and the six independent persona agents.

g.text: Maps pattern → persona · selects best fit · routes to correct agent
Each agent is independent · no shared memory · no cross-talk
6 independent agents · Claude Sonnet · own system prompt · own trigger · own output

svg.text: What makes this multi-agent: each persona has its own system prompt, trigger condition,
output format and cooldown — independent, no shared memory, no cross-talk between agents
